source: GHS-POP R2023A 30ss EPSG:4326 (persons per cell, CC BY 4.0)
method_note: cells[] is the 2-D field, accumulated from 30-arcsec persons-per-cell counts placed by their own geographic coordinates. lat_bands[] reproduces the 1-D longitude-collapsed field used by NASA DAS (NTRS 20170008876) so both casualty-expectancy methods can be computed on one footprint and compared.
